column1: # MANUAL.md coverage map. Checked by tests/manual_coverage.py (ctest: manual-coverage-contract).
# One row per behaviour the manual documents. Tab-separated: section, behaviour and
# status first; after them, a column of kind:name tokens is the evidence and any
# other text is the note (empty columns are ignored). The fields:
#   section    heading path as the manual writes it: "Chapter > Section[ > Subsection]"
#   behaviour  the claim being held to account, in a few words
#   status     auto | partial | manual | gap | n/a
#   evidence   ;-separated test:<Catch2 case> scenario:<name> bb:<runner leg> ctest:<name> script:<path>
#   note       why, for partial / manual / n/a; what is missing, for partial
# auto     a named test proves the behaviour
# partial  a named test proves part of it; the note says which part is not
# manual   cannot be automated here (the note says why); covered by the release walk
# n/a      describes rather than promises (overview, advice, links)
# The ceilings record the gap and partial counts. Covering a behaviour lowers one in the
# same change; a new gap raises one by hand, where review sees it.
